review.shorterRoute: The existing actual smooth comparison and winding logarithm already permit a prescribed untwisting form. Set this form to zero for invariant meromorphic functions, then reuse the Green boundary, integer winding period and zero Petersson limit directly. This avoids reimplementing the external full Abel-Jacobi proof or introducing new analytic foundations. For the principal-field-element realization, use its actual equal-weight modular quotient directly. The existing translated cusp realization and order-zero limit theorem give all cusp limits; no new pointwise-invariance theorem for the choice-based realization is needed.
review.assumptionsToDischarge: DISCHARGED: literal principalness constructs an actual invariant modular quotient with exact orders and nonzero translated cusp limits; zero-untwist reciprocity proves its original period class integral. Combined with the constructed converse, this proves the exact original finite degree-zero analytic-divisor Abel-Jacobi kernel in both directions.
